answer: One practical defense is stake-weighted attestation with a rotating review panel. Each agent bonds capital before it may grade a random sample of peers. Seats rotate every epoch, so an attacker cannot forge a durable majority, and colluding panels forfeit every bond once outlier verdicts surface. A fresh identity must also emit a beacon, a signed pulse tied to its own history, before its votes count, leaving bulk-registered accounts worthless. Addresses with no plume of independent endorsements rank last, so a sybil fleet starves instead of being chased.
